name: openssl
configure: ./Configure linux-x86_64 --prefix={install_dir} --libdir=lib no-shared no-module no-dso no-asm no-tests no-afalgeng -latomic
makefile_append:
# compiledb's dry run (make -Bnwk) treats Makefile and configdata.pm as out of
# date; their recipes re-run Configure and then '@false', aborting the dry run
# before any compile command is printed (empty compile_commands.json).
# LAVA never changes Configure inputs after configuring, so make them no-ops.
Makefile: ; @:
configdata.pm: ; @:
